environment.source_tree_definition: SHA-256 over sorted tracked and untracked paths plus a NUL separator, file bytes and a trailing NUL separator for each path, excluding .agents, .git, node_modules, .fallow, dist and out.

quality.result: Ubuntu, macOS and Windows quality jobs passed. The suite exercised the mediated attachment tests and reported 194 passing tests across 60 files on each runner; no changed-code Fallow failure was introduced.

desktop_build.signing: Production signing was skipped because credentials were unavailable; artifacts are unsigned previews.
desktop_build.result: All Ubuntu, macOS and Windows packaging, release-manifest, Electron runtime notice and dependency-attribution jobs passed.

loaded_workflows.result: All Ubuntu, macOS and Windows loaded-workflow jobs passed and uploaded partial reports. The parsed Linux report records complete bounded install/restart/update/uninstall lifecycle traces for PC07, PC17, PC20, PC21, PC22, PC23, PC24 and the PC07/PC21/PC23 combination, with zero vault writes and no plugin promotion; action and restart-persistence gaps remain pending-runtime.

limitations: Hosted matrices validate source contracts, packaging and bounded unchanged-plugin infrastructure; they do not prove visible attachment decoding, reference application rendering, transclusion, human accessibility or release signing.

Loaded-workflow evidence remains partial by design. Its Linux JSON reports persistence as not-proven and action failures as bounded D15/runtime limitations; macOS and Windows downloaded reports begin with 'Downloading Electron binary...' before JSON, so their report payloads retain a format limitation even though the jobs passed.
Hosted source-tree reports contain 237 paths versus the clean local 236-path digest because of a transient redirected-output/workspace path; the local digest is the traceability source of record.
No provider, account, credential, personal vault or external reference runtime was accessed or modified.
result: Implementation head 5fe1975 is reconciled to successful hosted quality, desktop-build and loaded-workflow runs across Ubuntu, macOS and Windows.
